cues: Inwards, inwards, outwards, inwards, inwards, inwards.
The cambium makes far more xylem than phloem, often several times more.
That is why a tree trunk is almost all wood.
text: Keep it going. Inwards, inwards, outwards, inwards, inwards, inwards. The cambium makes far more xylem than phloem, often several times more. That is why a tree trunk is almost all wood.
